A 24/7 Vice City livestream would be Rockstar’s biggest flex or its biggest risk.

Four fixed cameras. No commentary. No carefully selected trailer shots. Just GTA 6’s traffic, weather, police and NPCs running continuously.

Fans would find incredible unscripted moments. They’d also find every repeated animation and broken traffic pattern.

Would Rockstar ever be confident enough to let us watch?

Concept by u/Capital-Ad576 on Reddit.

author: gta6tracker
text:
Stephen Root has officially confirmed that he will star in GTA 6. 

Speaking at a pre-Emmys event, the acclaimed actor confirmed his involvement in Rockstar Games’ highly anticipated title, saying:

“I’m so happy to be involved with it.”

Fans had already suspected Root was voicing a character after recognizing his distinctive voice in previous GTA 6 footage, but this marks confirmation from the actor himself.

Root is known for roles in Barry, Office Space, King of the Hill, Succession and many more.
